run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery was severely constrained by the execution environment's network egress policy: all direct page fetches (WebFetch) to tender portals and buyer websites were blocked at the proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), including every Tier 1 government portal (AusTender, NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT, ACT), VendorPanel, data.gov.au, and even generic domains. Only the WebSearch tool (which routes through Anthropic infrastructure, not the egress proxy) was available. WebSearch returned real buyer-originated source pages but no verifiably-current open opportunities: every dated tender surfaced had a closing date already in the past (ranging from March to early September 2026), so none could honestly be recorded as open. No tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened, so no deliverables/requirements extraction was possible this run. Tier 3 corporate channels were confirmed as login/registration-gated (SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery, Coupa, Tenderlink, EstimateOne) and are recorded as sources only, not fabricated as tenders. The run's useful yield was source discovery: several genuinely new buyer-originated public-sector sources were identified via search.
gaps: CRITICAL: WebFetch outbound egress is fully blocked by the environment's network policy. Every attempted fetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including www.tenders.gov.au, www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, www.tenders.vic.gov.au, www.vendorpanel.com.au, data.gov.au and en.wikipedia.org. No tender portal, detail page, or specification document could be retrieved. This is the same constraint that produced 0 tenders on the preceding daily runs (2026-10-05 to 2026-10-09).

Tier 1 government portals (AusTender + all 8 state/territory eTendering sites) could not be queried live. Their current open-tender lists were not retrievable; WebSearch only returned stale cached snapshots whose closing dates have passed.

No opportunity could be confirmed as currently open or published/updated in the last 7 days. All dated tenders found via search had closing dates in the past (e.g. WA regional bulletin items closing 8-9 Sep 2026; Victorian cached items closing Jul 2026; various council RFTs closing Feb-Mar 2026). None were recorded, to avoid presenting closed tenders as open.
Deliverables / requirements / evaluation-criteria extraction was impossible this run: detail pages and tender documents are only reachable via WebFetch, which is blocked.

Tier 3 private sector: SAP Ariba / SAP Business Network Discovery could not be queried for live Australian RFx (blocked + registration-gated). Major-buyer portals (BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woolworths, Coles, Wesfarmers, Qantas, banks, telcos) expose opportunities only behind free supplier registration or invitation; no publicly-visible corporate RFx was confirmed. Invitation-only consultancy RFPs remain out of scope by definition.
VendorPanel public tenders (councils) could not be fetched; only individual council pages surfaced via search, all with past closing dates.
WebSearch is US-indexed and does not reliably reflect the current state of Australian tender portals, so even the source-discovery results may lag the live portals.
recommended_seed_additions: Whitelist the Tier 1 tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au, supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au) and vendorpanel.com.au in the environment's network egress policy so WebFetch can reach them — without this the routine cannot discover or detail tenders.
AusTender Supplier Portal (new federal supplier database; first tranche released Oct 2025, opening to all Australian businesses from 1 July 2026) — track as a Commonwealth source/channel change.
WA regional Development Commission tender bulletins (Kimberley, Goldfields-Esperance, Pilbara) as recurring regional discovery-signal publications pointing to buyer-originated listings.
Gippsland Water (gww.com.au) as a Victorian government-business-enterprise (water corporation) procurement source.
Wentworth Shire Council (NSW) local-government tenders page.

discovered_sources.how_discovered: WebSearch surfaced a current Wentworth Shire Council tender (Contract Reference PT2526/05) on the council's own website while searching NSW RFTs; the council publishes tenders directly on its own site.
discovered_sources.notes: Buyer-originated NSW local-government tender page. Could not be fetched this run (egress blocked); existence confirmed via search result only. The one item seen (PT2526/05) had already closed (2 Mar 2026).
